title: Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects

translated_title: 量化与高效适配的蛋白质语言模型分析
translated_abstract: 背景：蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）越来越多地被用于序列生成和性质预测，但其庞大的模型规模使得微调和部署成本高昂。量化和参数高效微调对性能、表示和生成的影响尚未得到充分表征。结果：我们在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3和Profluent-E1等多个模型上评估了4比特量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）的效果。在各类蛋白质预测任务中，许多模型-任务组合保留了超过90%的全量微调性能。对于最大的模型，峰值GPU显存节省接近90%，尽管性能和效率因模型、数据集和训练配置而有所不同。QLoRA通常能保留早期层的表示，同时在中层和后层层诱导出任务特定的适应，其表现类似于表示变化较小的全量微调。训练速度和功耗方面的影响……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究系统评估了4比特量化结合低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）在七种蛋白质语言模型上的效果，发现该方法可在节省高达90%GPU显存的同时保留超过90%的全量微调性能，且其表示变化模式与全量微调相似。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates 4-bit quantization with QLoRA fine-tuning across seven protein language models, showing that it retains over 90% of full fine-tuning performance while saving up to 90% of GPU memory, with representation changes resembling those of full fine-tuning.
